blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
HR has changed a lot over the last twenty years. It used to be mostly about contracts, payroll and paperwork. Today, HR is a real partner to the business, not a back-office function.

Strategic HR means that every HR decision is connected to the company's goals. If the business is growing fast, HR focuses on recruitment. If the business wants to retain talent, HR looks at engagement and development.

A good HR leader can read the business plan and translate it into people priorities — the right hires, the right training, the right culture to make the strategy work.

items.q: According to the text, what was HR mostly about in the past?
items.why: "It used to be mostly about contracts, payroll and paperwork."

items.q: What does "strategic HR" mean, according to the text?
options: HR runs the business plan for the executives
Every HR decision is connected to the company's goals
HR outsources payroll to save costs
HR reports to the CEO directly
items.why: "Strategic HR means that every HR decision is connected to the company's goals."

items.q: If the business wants to retain talent, what does HR look at?
items.why: "If the business wants to retain talent, HR looks at engagement and development."

items.q: The text suggests that a good HR leader must be able to…
options: focus only on hiring the cheapest candidates
understand the business plan and turn it into people priorities
avoid getting involved in company strategy
items.why: Inferência: ler o plano de negócios e "translate it into people priorities" é a competência-chave descrita.

items.q: Which statement would the author most likely DISAGREE with?
options: HR is now a partner to the business.
The right culture helps a strategy succeed.
HR decisions should support the company's goals.
HR is best kept as a back-office function that handles paperwork.
items.why: Inferência: o texto argumenta justamente que o RH foi além do back-office e virou parceiro do negócio.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Sophie apresentar o plano de RH à diretoria. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Thank you all for making the time. What I want to show you today is not a list of HR activities — it's how each people priority supports one of the business goals you set for next year.

Your first goal is to grow revenue by twenty per cent. For us, that means recruitment and onboarding. We have already mapped the roles we need, and we can start hiring in the first quarter. So the plan is built around speed to productivity, not just headcount.

Your second goal is to protect the margin, which depends on keeping our best people. Over the last year we have lost too many strong performers to competitors, so retention is now a priority. We will invest in development and manager training, because people usually leave a manager, not a company.

None of this is HR working on its own. Every number on this slide is tied to a business outcome you can measure. If a priority doesn't drive one of your goals, it won't be on the plan.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What does Sophie say her presentation is really about?
options: How each people priority supports a business goal
New payroll software for the company
A list of HR activities for next year
items.why: "it's how each people priority supports one of the business goals you set."

items.q: How does Sophie connect the goal of growing revenue to HR?
items.why: "Your first goal is to grow revenue… that means recruitment and onboarding."

items.q: Why has retention become a priority this year?
options: The executives asked for fewer hires
The company has lost too many strong performers to competitors
The HR team wants a bigger budget
items.why: "we have lost too many strong performers to competitors, so retention is now a priority."

items.q: What does Sophie imply by saying "people usually leave a manager, not a company"?
options: Salary is the only reason people quit
Improving management quality can help keep talent
The company brand does not matter
items.why: Inferência: por isso ela investe em treinamento de gestores — melhorar a liderança reduz a saída de talentos.

items.q: What can we infer about how Sophie decides what goes on the plan?
options: She lets each manager add their own items
She only keeps priorities that drive a measurable business goal
She includes every HR activity to look busy
She copies last year's plan without changes
items.why: Inferência: "If a priority doesn't drive one of your goals, it won't be on the plan."

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "Our job is to align HR priorities with the business plan." To align means to…
options: reduce the size of a department
put things in the same direction so they support each other
items.why: Align = alinhar: colocar na mesma direção para que trabalhem juntos.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "We need a strong strategy to ___ our best engineers before they leave."
items.why: Retain = reter: manter os talentos na empresa.

items.q: "HR is now a real business partner." A business partner is best described as…
options: the person who owns the company
a function that helps shape and deliver the company's strategy
a team that only handles paperwork
items.why: Business partner = parceiro de negócios: participa da estratégia, não é só suporte.

items.q: Choose the correct phrase: "A good leader can ___ the business plan ___ clear people actions."
items.why: Translate into = traduzir em: transformar o plano em ações concretas.

items.q: "These initiatives should drive better business results." Here, drive means to…
items.why: Drive = impulsionar, gerar resultados — sentido figurado nos negócios.

blocks.instruction: Expressões e phrasal verbs que aparecem em reuniões de RH e estratégia. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "The executive committee still has to sign off on the HR budget." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar formalmente, dar o aval final.

items.q: "We will roll out the new development programme team by team." To roll out means to…
items.why: Roll out = implementar de forma progressiva.

items.q: "Two directors pushed back on the hiring plan." They…
items.why: Push back on = resistir, discordar — sem necessariamente rejeitar de vez.

items.q: "HR agreed to improve retention but never followed through." They…
options: failed to carry it to completion
items.why: Follow through = levar até o fim o que foi combinado.

items.q: "A one-off training day won't move the needle on engagement." This means it will…
items.why: Move the needle = mexer o ponteiro, fazer diferença perceptível.
